name: forget
description: Make FRED forget one thing it has learned about the user. Say which one by its number or by a few words from it. Asks the user to confirm first; the item is hidden everywhere and kept only in the private log.

item.description: the item's number (from recall with no query) or a few words from it

examples: forget that I like spicy food
stop remembering that I wake up at six
delete what you know about my gym routine
I don't want you to remember my exam schedule
